races.display_title: Cork Maiden
races.verdict: A huge field but only a handful make any serious appeal. Preference is for OTSANA , who shaped with considerable promise when fifth at the Curragh on debut last month and now drops to 6f. She can get the better of Saint Agatha , who is yet to progress from her debut, but a first-time tongue tie could be just what's required. Noble Irish and Inform are newcomers representing powerful connections so they complete the shortlist. OTSANA (IRE) SAINT AGATHA (IRE) NOBLE IRISH (IRE)
